patch.description:
Each location type of the [Zoom Rooms location hierarchy](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115000342983-Zoom-Rooms-Location-Hierarchy) has a profile page that includes information such as name of the location, address, support email, etc. Use this API to update information about a specific Zoom Rooms location type such as information about the city where the Zoom Rooms is located. **Prerequisite:**
* Account owner or admin permission * Zoom Rooms version 4.0 or higher
**Scopes:*

get.description:
Scheduling a [Webinar with registration](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/204619915-Scheduling-a-Webinar-with-Registration) requires your registrants to complete a brief form with fields and questions before they can receive the link to join the Webinar.
Use this API to list registration questions and fields that are to be answered by users while registering for a Webinar.
**Prerequisites:**
* Pro or higher plan with a Webinar Add-on. **Scopes:** `webinar:read:admin` `webin
